title: Florian Fackler | AI Automation for Swiss SMEs
description: Privacy-focused AI automation for Swiss SMEs. Workflow automation, document processing, AI assistants. Your data stays in Switzerland.
hero_tagline: AI solutions for Swiss companies that run on your own systems or in Swiss data centers. Data protection is built in from the start, not added later. 25+ years of experience turning technology into a real advantage for your business.
usp_1_text:
Your competitors copy sensitive data into ChatGPT every day. I build AI that runs on your own systems or in Swiss data centers. Nothing goes abroad, nothing leaves Switzerland.

No data leaks, fully compliant, and real work gets done.
usp_2_list: An AI assistant that knows your business and answers questions based on your own documents.
Automated tasks that save real hours every week. No showpiece demos.
Email handling that sorts, drafts replies, and routes messages for you.
A partner who translates between technology and business.
usp_3_list: 71% of Swiss SMEs use or test AI right now.
85% use ChatGPT, but only a third have rules for handling data safely.
62% can't find the right people to help them keep up.
